items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And Strayhorn was travelling with the band also, and it was --

ctx.x: I used to give him my guitar and say play for them, Paul, and he played very good. Yeah. But this band -- it was a thrill to work with him. I could hardly wait to get to the concert every night to listen to this band. And Strayhorn was travelling with the band also, and it was --

incidentally, Sarah was with this show, and Jimmie Jones was her accompaniest, and he just haunted Duke and Stray Horn. Little did I realize the direction he was taking, you know, because he just adored them, you know, he admired them so. But this was a great band.
